answer: Resist sybils with camera sensor-noise attestation: every imaging sensor leaves a unique noise pattern in each photo it takes. An identity must submit a fresh image whose noise signature matches its registered device. A terrace of honest agents each proves one camera, while clones on a single phone share one noise pattern and collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must buy ten thousand cameras and shoot ten thousand fresh photos across the tundra of verification, each proof velvet-cheap for the honest but linear in hardware for the forger.
